## Purpose

Billing takes the money for a chosen week: whenever meals are chosen it charges the household's card through Stripe and tells the rest of the system the week is paid. It owns no product rules — a failed charge is reported back to subscriptions, which decides what to do.

## Strategic classification

| Domain | Business model | Evolution |
|---|---|---|
| generic | cost-reducer | commodity |

_Strategize rationale_: Charging a card weekly is a solved problem (Stripe, commodity evolution); it moves no goal on its own, so buy the provider and keep our side a transaction script around the adapter. — _future_: Remains generic; revisit only if we move to invoicing B2B customers

## Domain roles

**execution-context** — Execution context around a bought capability: it reacts to meals-chosen and executes the charge through the Stripe ACL; no model of its own beyond the charge record.

## Business decisions

1. A week is charged exactly once, on meals-chosen; retries are idempotent on subscriptionId+week
2. A declined card pauses the subscription and releases the week
